title: 全村公敌
logline: Li Xiaokang refuses the village's buy-out and backs the developer's share contract; when the developer suddenly pays everyone more, he senses a trap.

clips.summary: At {loc}, {dahua} screams at {xiaokang} for betraying the village, and {cunmin} leads the crowd in shouting him out.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: an angry murmuring crowd, a dog barking far off, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 李小康，你是不是脑子有病！
cuts.say: 李小康！你是不是脑子有病？！
cuts.act: 双手叉腰，尖着嗓子破口大骂，气急败坏
cuts.delivery: screaming furiously, face flushed red, eyes bulging
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} filling the centre of the frame in harsh sunlight; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, out of focus.
cuts.action: {dahua} jabs a finger toward the camera, hands on hips between jabs, spittle flying as she shouts.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 关键时刻，你居然背叛我们！
cuts.say: 关键时刻——你居然背叛我们！
cuts.act: 手指几乎戳到他脸上，越骂越激动，嗓门更大
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s light-blue shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {dahua} faces the camera in the left third, the red archway behind her.
cuts.action: {dahua} steps in so close her finger nearly touches his face.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 我们黄谷村不要叛徒！滚出去！
cuts.say: 我们黄谷村不要叛徒！滚出去！
cuts.act: 振臂高喊，带头起哄，粗声大吼
cuts.delivery: bellowing, rallying the crowd, fist raised
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin} in the right two-thirds of the frame, straw hat pushed back; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, raising fists.
cuts.action: {cunmin} punches his fist into the air as he shouts; the villagers behind him raise their fists too.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: The crowd chants at {xiaokang}, who stands alone clutching his shirt; his inner voice says he became the whole village's enemy that day.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: a crowd chanting rhythmically, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} standing alone in the centre of the dirt clearing of {loc}; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, encircling him and chanting.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} grips the hem of his shirt with both hands, jaw clenched, eyes moving across the hostile faces.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude, at slow speed.
cuts.sound: The villagers chant and shake their fists.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 那一天，我成了全村的公敌。
cuts.say: 那一天……我成了全村的公敌。
cuts.act: 低沉的内心独白，苦涩，带着一点自嘲
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in three-quarter profile, sunlight on his cheek, the crowd a blur behind him.
cuts.action: His eyes drop to the ground; he swallows hard.
cuts.end: The shot ends on his eyes in extreme close-up.

clips.summary: Earlier at {loc}: {dahua} mocks {gaoliang}'s offer of fifty thousand per household, {cunmin} demands more, and {gaoliang} calmly asks if nobody will sign the share contract.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: a restless crowd murmuring, papers rustling on the tables, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 高总，拆一户才给五万，你打发叫花子呢？
cuts.say: 高总，拆一户才给五万……你打发叫花子呢？
cuts.act: 叉腰冷笑，阴阳怪气地挖苦
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} in the left two-thirds of the frame, the folding tables and contract stacks soft behind her.
cuts.action: {dahua} looks the businessman up and down, lips curled in contempt.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: cunmin
cuts.line: 必须加钱！不加我们不签！
cuts.say: 必须加钱！不加——我们不签！
cuts.act: 粗着嗓子带头喊，拍着桌子
cuts.delivery: shouting, slamming his palm on the table
cuts.composition: Close-up of {cunmin} leaning over the folding table; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.action: {cunmin} slams his palm on the contract stack.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.line: 好，你们都不签原始股的合同是吧？
cuts.say: 好。你们……都不签原始股的合同，是吧？
cuts.act: 慢条斯理，面带微笑，话里藏着锋芒
cuts.delivery: smiling politely, eyes cold behind his glasses
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang} seated at the table, centre-right of the frame, the crowd blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} slowly stands, adjusts his glasses with one finger and smiles without warmth.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {xiaokang} pushes through the crowd and shouts that he will sign the share contract; his father {shoudi} is stunned.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: the crowd falls into a shocked silence, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 我签！我签原始股的合同！
cuts.say: 我签！我签原始股的合同！
cuts.act: 从人群里挤出来，鼓起勇气大声喊，声音发紧
cuts.delivery: shouting with nervous resolve, chest heaving
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} pushing forward out of the crowd, centre of the frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, turning to stare at him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} shoves between two villagers and raises his hand high.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.act: 愣住，又惊又慌，声音发颤
cuts.delivery: stunned, mouth falling open, voice shaking
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi} in the left two-thirds of the frame among the crowd, squinting in the sunlight.
cuts.action: {shoudi}'s eyes widen; he half reaches toward his son and stops.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {dahua} turns on {xiaokang}, who tries to explain that shares are worth more than cash; she wails that he will ruin them all.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: an angry crowd muttering, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 好啊李小康，你书都读到狗肚子里去了！
cuts.say: 好啊，李小康！你书都读到狗肚子里去了！
cuts.act: 气得发抖，咬牙切齿地骂
cuts.composition: {xiaokang}'s shoulder blurs in the right foreground; {dahua} faces the camera in the left third.
cuts.action: {dahua} slaps her own thigh and points at him.
cuts.camera: Static camera, focus held on the speaker's eyes.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 钱是死的，股份是活的，长远看股票更划算！
cuts.say: 钱是死的，股份是活的……长远看，还是股票更划算！
cuts.act: 急切地解释，恳切，努力让大家听进去
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in the right two-thirds of the frame, sunlight on his face.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} opens both palms toward the crowd, searching their faces.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 你懂个屁！这是要把我们都毁了啊！
cuts.say: 你懂个屁！这……这是要把我们都毁了啊！
cuts.act: 拍着大腿哭嚎起来，撒泼打滚的哭腔
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} centre frame; a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background.
cuts.action: {dahua} slaps both thighs and wails, tears running down her red face.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: {gaoliang} raises a hand and announces fifteen thousand more per household; {dahua} cheers and {xiaokang} stares in disbelief.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: the crowd erupts into cheering and clapping, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: gaoliang
cuts.say: 好！那就依各位的——每户，再加十五万！
cuts.act: 抬手示意安静，笑容满面，声音洪亮
cuts.composition: Close-up of {gaoliang} standing at the table, one hand raised, centre-left of the frame.
cuts.action: {gaoliang} lifts his hand for silence, then spreads it wide with a generous smile.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.composition: Medium shot of {xiaokang} frozen in the middle of {loc} while a loose crowd of unnamed villagers in simple rural clothes fills the background, jumping and clapping around him.
cuts.action: The villagers cheer and slap each other's backs; {xiaokang} stands still, staring toward the businessman in disbelief.
cuts.camera: Slow push in, with small amplitude, at slow speed.

cuts.speaker: dahua
cuts.line: 我就说嘛！高总是大老板！
cuts.say: 我就说嘛！高总是大老板！
cuts.act: 笑开了花，拍手叫好，嗓门洪亮
cuts.composition: Close-up of {dahua} centre frame, grinning, the crowd cheering behind her.
cuts.action: {dahua} claps her hands over her head, beaming.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

clips.summary: As everyone rushes to sign, {xiaokang} senses a trap; {shoudi} asks why he did not sign, and he says this contract must not be signed.
clips.soundscape: Outdoor village ambience: villagers chattering happily at the tables, pens scratching, wind through the cornfields.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 高亮答应得这么爽快，事情没那么简单。
cuts.say: 高亮答应得这么爽快……事情，没那么简单。
cuts.act: 低声的内心独白，警觉，满是怀疑
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in three-quarter profile watching the signing tables, the crowd a blur behind him.
cuts.action: His eyes narrow as he watches the businessman smile at the queue of villagers.

cuts.speaker: shoudi
cuts.composition: Close-up of {shoudi} in the left two-thirds of the frame, glancing toward the tables.
cuts.action: {shoudi} tugs at his son's sleeve, brows knotted.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.

cuts.speaker: xiaokang
cuts.line: 爸，你相信我，这合同不能签！
cuts.say: 爸，你相信我……这合同，不能签！
cuts.act: 压低声音但无比坚定，一字一顿
cuts.delivery: low, steady and certain, eyes locked on his father
cuts.composition: Close-up of {xiaokang} in the right two-thirds of the frame, the signing tables blurred behind him.
cuts.action: {xiaokang} turns to his father and holds his gaze.
cuts.camera: Static camera with a barely perceptible handheld breathing.
cuts.end: His jaw sets; he does not look away.

music: rural Chinese comedy drama underscore, erhu, pipa, plucked strings, light percussion, playful tension, mid tempo, instrumental, no vocals
